status: v1 accepted by owner 2026-10-20 (OD-3); first tests still verify behavior against real git
rules: Declared by WorkHarbor policy; never derived from, merged with or read from the host.
Rendered deterministically (this order, git config syntax, trailing newline) and delivered read-only; GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL points to it and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1.

No user.name or user.email: identity comes only from GIT_AUTHOR_NAME, GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL, GIT_COMMITTER_NAME and GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL supplied by the operator. user.useConfigOnly makes git fail instead of guessing.

Before first usable release, review key/value, renderer and current conformance-test changes together; no new profile_version or historical reader is required solely for compatibility. Keep current profile metadata/type validation and record the exact rendered hash in instance labels and manifest.

entries.rationale: deterministic branch name for new repositories
git fails instead of guessing an identity; identity comes from the operator variables
no recorded resolutions reused across jobs
no host signing key in a job
no host signing key in a job
no helper process started by git
blocks the ext:: transport that runs commands
clears inherited global and system helpers (not repository-local ones)
